meta.reporting_rules: say 'text (TF-IDF)', never 'text' alone; never pair R2 EXCEEDS with R7 NULL as 'directional, not spectral', nor R1 REPRODUCED with R2 EXCEEDS as 'the paper's result reproduces and beats text', nor the registered power with NOT_DISTINGUISHED as 'a well-powered null' (prereg §5.3)

fingerprint.reference: May's bridge run (default HF cache), not v2's cache: it does not gate R1 (prereg §5.1)
fingerprint.note: the norm part is insensitive to weight changes that keep k_norm; the witness is the sensitive part

verdicts.R1_note: R2 is read and reported whatever R1 is (prereg §5.1)

outcome_sentences: A raw-residual LR baseline (res_out) reaches 0.494 >= R2's 0.358: the probe's information is in the residual stream without W_K or the cache, and the paper may not say that W_K or the KV cache adds to it.

A raw-residual LR baseline (res_in_ln) reaches 0.490 >= R2's 0.358: the probe's information is in the residual stream without W_K or the cache, and the paper may not say that W_K or the KV cache adds to it.
A tuned text (TF-IDF) baseline reaches 0.448 >= R2's 0.358: the comparison with the untuned R0 may not be cited as the cache beating text.

band.source: bf16 run-to-run only (v2 ran in bf16, v2:107)

R1.fwl_note: v2's FWL: fitted on each fold's own test trials (v2:227); label-free; kept for fidelity

permutation.scheme: the 30 emotion labels permuted over the 30 cells within each topic
permutation.statistic: R2 primary's own 30-way accuracy, the whole pipeline refit per draw (directions re-estimated; no TF-IDF involved). It tests R2 against chance and leakage, NOT R2 > R0.

power.note: power of the exact McNemar on prediction-level gains, not of a latent cache signal; McNemar also treats 900 trials as independent while the unit is 300 cells (optimistic)

robustness.estimand: accuracy(R2) - accuracy(R0, 10 folds), observed delta with percentile intervals

S1_R1_vs_R0file_30way.fwl_note: R1 carries v2's FWL: fitted on each fold's own test trials (v2:227), label-free

S2_R1_vs_R0file_valence.fwl_note: R1 carries v2's FWL: fitted on each fold's own test trials (v2:227), label-free

S4_R2primary_vs_R0file_30way.note: R2 trains on 90% (10 folds), the R0 file on 80% (5 folds): a training-set asymmetry in R2's favour

per_trial.note: grid preds are indices into meta.emotions; R1 preds are names
